## Bocconi University · IGIER {.unnumbered}

**Predoctoral Research Assistant** to **Giulia Giupponi** and **Thomas Le Barbanchon**

- Text-as-data analysis of open-ended answers in a survey on pension reform in Denmark, using a local open-weight large language model and transformer classifiers (BERTopic, DeBERTa).
- Design of the coding scheme and the classification pipeline for the NLP part of the project.
- Preparation of the replication package of a paper on the impact of hiring frictions on firm performance, in response to referee requests.

## Sciences Po · Department of Economics {.unnumbered}

**Research Assistant** to **Jean-Marc Robin**

- Processing and analysis of large-scale matched employer-employee administrative data (DADS) for a project on wage dynamics and human capital accumulation.
- Implementation of a ridge estimator for high-dimensional two-way fixed effects (AKM) models to address limited mobility bias, compared with OLS and with bias-corrected estimators (debiased OLS, KSS).
- Port of the estimation code from MATLAB to Julia and R, which significantly improved computational efficiency when computing bias corrections and variance-covariance matrices on very large datasets.
